environment.background: ordinary desktop services; sequential study jobs
environment.cache: OS caches warm and uncontrolled; fresh browser contexts

interpretation.observation: Instrumented local source traces and trusted browser edit/Apply actions.
interpretation.percentiles: Each percentile describes one run. Five run summaries and their ranges remain separate.
interpretation.clocks: Values retain measured timer overhead and zero observations. Frame opportunity measures callback opportunity rather than painted pixels.
interpretation.residual: Receiver remainder is handler time less wrapped model spans, clamped per event; it includes instrumentation and other receiver work.
interpretation.transfer: These synthetic fixtures describe the pinned implementation on one local environment.
